recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: structured data mined from scattered webpages
single-board computers getting stricter default configs
merchant lanes thinning through a narrow strait
overcast summer fog holding the bay at fourteen degrees

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Tap stutter-house beat drops as overcast fog pulses across a wireframe skyline — miss a gap and the loop glitches.
composer-2.5-fast.mechanic: rhythm tap on off-grid stutter beats
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: nail one flawless four-bar loop before the fog clears
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: BPM stutters widen, ghost notes appear between real hits
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: neon wireframe fog over muted summer gray

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Flick drifting webpage shards into JSON buckets — each shard is unstructured HTML, each bucket wants a field type.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: chain three clean parses for a satisfying cascade collapse
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: wind shear drifts shards mid-air, bucket labels multiply
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: paper cutout browser tabs tumbling in overcast light

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Drag cargo containers into correct strait lanes before the waterway clogs — weight class, destination, and urgency all matter.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.mechanic: sort and slot under time pressure
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: clear a backlog stack in under sixty seconds
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: lanes narrow, mis-sorts bounce back and stack higher
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: watercolor nautical charts with faded red lane markers

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Draw one-thumb sailing paths for a yacht-rock vessel through dream-pop jellyfish blooms in a hazy SF bay.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: one clean crossing from pier to open water scores instantly
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: jellyfish pulse to ambient celtic rhythms, fog closes viable corridors
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: soft yacht-rock pastel haze with translucent sea creatures
